title: Ask about feature tool feedback in adj and file it when answered
lead: *Proposed.* Depends on `ork-tool-feedback-file`. A `feature` entry becomes an open adj question in the target project, so it appears in Needs you with no TUI change. When the record is decided with option `file`, by the owner or by the relay-session orchestrator as the owner's delegate, ork files the slice.
findings_note: 2026-11-17 spec draft of S320 at f48a6154. Open adj records already show in Needs you: the daemon counts `len(s.Open.Value)` (`internal/daemon/handlers.go:460`) and the Overview lists each open record (`internal/tui/overview.go:360-363`). `AskRecord` checks the key first and refuses one that exists (`internal/engine/adjrecord.go:112-127`). The source cache fetches decided records (`internal/source/source.go:152`), and the daemon already wraps the cache fetcher to act on a fetched part (`landingFetcher`, `internal/daemon/landed.go:22-37`).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The S320 Why asks that design-level items reach Needs you as an adj question with options and a recommendation. No engine step runs `adj ask` today (`rg -n "Adj\.Ask\(" internal` finds none), and `docs/boundaries.md:97-101` says only an explicit owner action runs `adj decide`: "No role and no automatic step triggers it."

Owner decisions (2026-11-17, relay session 8d711f67): the question has options `file` and `drop` and recommends `file` (adj 415 `feedback.question-shape`, `file-drop`); the relay-session orchestrator may answer `file`/`drop` as the owner's delegate, citing the session (adj 416 `feedback.who-answers`, `delegate`). The target follows adj 412 and the key adj 414, as in the first slice.

*Proposed:*

- Ask: for a `feature` entry, `AskRecord` in the target project (adj on) with key `tool-feedback.SLUG-HASH` (the first slice's key with its first `-` after `tool-feedback` as `.`, which fits `decisionKey`, `internal/engine/report.go:113`), title `Tool feedback (feature, SLUG): PROPOSAL` cut to 120 characters, context whose first line is `Proposal: PROPOSAL` then the role, run, project, item and evidence, options `file` ("ork files it as a slice in TARGET") and `drop` ("not acted on"), recommendation `file` with reasoning "A role proposed it; code cannot judge its cost.", ref the item when the target is the run's own project. The entry gets `asked` (the adj id).
- A target without adj, or a key that already exists, leaves `file_error` on the entry and asks nothing; never an error of the run.
- File on decision: the daemon's fetcher wrapper, on each fetched `decided` part, takes records whose key starts with `tool-feedback.` and whose decision is `file`, and that it has not handled since start, and files each with the first slice's filer in that project: the title from the `Proposal:` line, slicer key `tool-feedback-SLUG-HASH`, `--discovered-from` the first ref when there is one. `drop` files nothing. Because `--key` returns the existing item, a restart that sees the record again files nothing new.
- One path for every answerer: the TUI and `ork adj answer` refresh the decided part (`internal/daemon/adjwrite.go:30`); a delegate's direct `adj decide` is seen on the next refresh. ork itself never runs `adj decide` for these records.
- Boundaries exception (adj 416): `docs/boundaries.md:97-101` gains that a `tool-feedback.*` question may also be decided by the relay-session orchestrator as the owner's delegate, with `--by` the owner and a `--why` that cites the session; still no role and no automatic ork step runs `adj decide`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestToolFeedbackFeatureIsAskedInAdj` (`internal/engine`, fake adj): a `kind: feature | tool: ork` line in a run of `ork` with adj on runs `adj check tool-feedback.ork-XXXXXXXX`, then `adj ask` with that key, options `file` and `drop`, recommendation `file`; the entry has `asked`. Fails first: the first slice only keeps a feature entry.
- `TestToolFeedbackAskedTwiceIsNotReasked` (`internal/engine`): fake `adj check` returns `open #12`; no `adj ask` runs and `file_error` names #12. Fails first: no ask route.
- `TestToolFeedbackAskSkipsAProjectWithoutAdj` (`internal/engine`): target with `Adj: false` makes no adj call and sets `file_error`. Fails first: no ask route.
- `TestDecidedToolFeedbackFileIsFiledOnce` (`internal/daemon`): a fetched decided part with record #20 `tool-feedback.ork-XXXXXXXX`, decision `file`, context `Proposal: Show the run id`, runs `slicer add "Show the run id" --key tool-feedback-ork-XXXXXXXX` and `promote` once; a second fetch runs nothing. Fails first: the wrapper acts only on `source.Head` (`internal/daemon/landed.go:31`).
- `TestDecidedToolFeedbackDropAndOtherKeysFileNothing` (`internal/daemon`): decision `drop`, or decision `file` on key `feedback.when`, runs no slicer call. Fails first: guards the new wrapper branch; it cannot compile before the handler exists.
- `TestDecidedToolFeedbackByDelegateIsFiled` (`internal/daemon`): a record decided outside ork (decided_by `Jon`, rationale citing a session) and first seen on a scheduled refresh is filed. Fails first: no wrapper branch.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests above and watch each go red.
2. The ask route and the `asked` field, called from the first slice's filer for `feature` entries.
3. `FileDecidedToolFeedback` and the `source.Decided` branch of the fetcher wrapper, with an in-memory set of handled record ids.
4. Docs: `docs/boundaries.md:97-101` the delegate exception (adj 416), stating that no automatic ork step runs `adj decide`; `docs/design.md` ask route and filing on decision (adj 415, 416); `docs/state.md`; `docs/orchestrator-parity.md`. Mark all *proposed*.
5. CHANGELOG.md: one bullet under `## Unreleased`.

Not a UI slice: Needs you already lists open adj records (`internal/tui/overview.go:360-363`); no change to `internal/tui`, `docs/dashboard.md` or CLI output.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:

- After a run whose role reports a 'feature' line for a target with adj on, 'adj inbox --root TARGETPATH' lists 'tool-feedback.SLUG-XXXXXXXX' with options 'file' and 'drop' and recommendation 'file', and the TUI's Needs you shows it as a decision row.
- The same proposal in a later run asks nothing new: 'adj inbox' lists it once.
- Answering 'file' in the TUI or with 'ork adj answer' files one slice in the target; 'slicer show ID --root TARGETPATH' shows the proposal as title. 'drop' files nothing.
- A delegate's 'adj decide ID --option file --by Jon --why "...session..."' leads to the same single slice after the next refresh.
- 'docs/boundaries.md' names the delegate exception for 'tool-feedback.*' questions and still says no automatic step runs 'adj decide'.

Commands:

- `go vet ./...` exits 0.
- `go test ./...` exits 0.
- `go test ./internal/engine ./internal/daemon -run 'ToolFeedback' -v` lists the six new tests as passing.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check --root /home/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork` exits 0.
- `adj lint` exits 0.
- `rg -n "Adj\.(Decide|DecideOption)\(" internal/engine/toolfeedback.go internal/daemon/toolfeedback.go` prints nothing.
- `rg -n "adj 416" docs/boundaries.md` finds the exception.
- [HUMAN CHECK] In a real run, a feature line reaches Needs you, and answering `file` files one slice in the target.
